About us

An editorial project about hair care at home

Haircare Italia collects simple recipes for looking after your hair with kitchen ingredients, written clearly and cautiously.

We care about method more than trends: saying what is in it, how long it keeps, when to stop and when to see a professional. We are not hairdressers or dermatologists, and we do not sell finished cosmetics.

How we behave

1Clarity

Amounts, times and steps written so anyone can follow them.

2Caution

Patch test, small amounts, short storage. Safety comes before results.

3Honesty

No promises we cannot keep and no invented effects.
